gate_resolved_by: human:Dalton 2026-08-11 — AC-3=relabel-only; fix=query-shape MATERIALIZED CTE on the current (write) connection (no zod re-route)
reconcile: best-of-4 (fast-pass + 3 blind candidates); unanimous on root cause & that DEV-2309 does not cover this; disagreement on FIX APPROACH surfaced as an open question, not silently resolved.
synthesis: SendEndOfShiftSummary (dispatched right after a shift closes — confirmed via ClarityScoutShiftController::end():143, or assumed via CloseInactiveShiftsCommand:91) exhausts its 5 retries with a Postgres SQLSTATE[57014] statement timeout while building the shift summary, so the summary never sends. handle() wraps its ENTIRE body in one DB::connection('platform')->transaction() that also holds lockForUpdate() on the kit_shifts row (for cross-dispatch idempotency). The only heavy, non-trivial query in that path is BuildShiftSummary::buildZoneSummaries() (app/Services/Scout/BuildShiftSummary.php:178-193): a raw-SQL INNER JOIN of the giant partitioned public.scans against platform.zones ON ST_Contains(z.geom, s.geo), scoped only by kit_id + [started_at,ended_at] + org_id, with NO fence forcing the small scan set to be computed before the spatial predicate. TWO reinforcing causes: (1) query SHAPE — a zones/geo-GiST-driven plan can evaluate ST_Contains across an unbounded scan volume before the kit_id/time filters bind; (2) CONNECTION PINNING — because the SELECT runs inside the open 'platform' transaction, Laravel's getReadPdo() forces it onto the WRITE PDO (verified vendor Connection.php:1280: transactions>0 → write pdo), i.e. the primary, which plausibly carries a stricter statement_timeout than the 'zod' read replica DEV-2309's analogous query used. This is NOT the ScanTimezoneScope global-scope bug — buildZoneSummaries is raw SQL that never instantiates the Scan Eloquent model, so DEV-2309's withoutGlobalScope fix is structurally inapplicable. Same family, different unfixed instance.

scope.summary: DECIDED (Dalton 2026-08-11): (1) bound buildZoneSummaries() with a MATERIALIZED CTE pre-filter on the CURRENT ('platform') connection — no zod re-route; (2) AC-3 = relabel the terminal-failure summary_skipped_reason to a build/timeout-specific value distinct from 'mail_failed', keeping the existing Log::error (no new alert channel).

proposed_changes.change: CHOSEN: rewrite buildZoneSummaries() raw SQL (178-193) with a WITH shift_scans AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, scanned_at, geo FROM public.scans WHERE kit_id=? AND scanned_at BETWEEN ? AND ?) fence, then JOIN shift_scans s ⋈ platform.zones z ON public.ST_Contains(z.geom, s.geo) WHERE z.org_id=? AND z.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.scanned_at, z.id. MATERIALIZED forces the small kit+window scan set (via the (kit_id,scanned_at) btree + partition pruning) to be computed before the spatial predicate. KEEP the read on the current DB::connection('platform') object. Optionally add a bbox (z.geom && s.geo) pre-filter as belt-and-suspenders (implementer's discretion). PRESERVE exact current semantics: same output columns + ORDER BY, and it still counts ALL scans incl hidden (raw SQL intentionally bypasses ShowVisibleScan — do NOT add an is_visible filter).
proposed_changes.reason: Directly satisfies AC-2 ('the timing-out query is bounded/optimized') and is robust regardless of DB node / statement_timeout. Matches DEV-2220/DEV-1898 precedent of pushing filtering into the DB.

proposed_changes.change: REJECTED (Dalton): do NOT re-route the reads to DB::connection('zod'). Keeping them on 'platform' avoids the replica-lag undercount of the just-closed shift's freshest scans; the MATERIALIZED CTE bounds the cost so the write-node timeout is no longer a concern.
proposed_changes.reason: The connection re-route (candidate 3) relied on the replica having a looser statement_timeout (unverifiable from code) and traded fresh-read semantics for it. The query-shape fix makes the node moot without that tradeoff.

proposed_changes.change: CHOSEN (AC-3 = relabel only): in failed(), record a build/query-timeout-specific summary_skipped_reason (e.g. 'build_failed') for a terminal Throwable surfaced from BuildShiftSummary::forShift(), distinct from the existing 'mail_failed' used for a genuine Mail-send failure. Keep the existing Log::error (Nightwatch already ingests it). Do NOT add a new proactive alert channel. varchar(64) column, no check constraint → no migration.
proposed_changes.reason: failed() (125-142) already records a skip reason + logs for ANY Throwable (DEV-1788, pinned by an existing test), so AC-3's letter is met — Dalton chose to make the label accurate (timeout vs mail) rather than add alerting the repo has no convention for.

questions.q: Does DEV-2309's merged fix (withoutGlobalScope(ScanTimezoneScope)) already cover this ticket?
questions.answer: No. DEV-2309 fixed Eloquent Scan::query() aggregates on the 'zod' connection (CloseInactiveShiftsCommand::latestActivityFor, EnsureOpenShift). DEV-2325's offending query is raw SQL on the 'platform' connection in buildZoneSummaries() that never instantiates the Scan model/global scope — a different call site, table pair (scans⋈zones vs scans⋈timezones) and mechanism. Verified against DEV-2309's merged diff + current source by all candidates.

questions.q: Why does it time out on the 'platform' WRITE connection and not the 'zod' read replica?
questions.answer: handle() wraps the body in DB::connection('platform')->transaction(); Laravel getReadPdo() returns the WRITE pdo whenever transactions>0 (verified vendor Connection.php:1280), so the raw SELECT is forced onto the primary purely because it executes inside that open transaction (independent of sticky).

questions.q: Is re-routing the reads to the 'zod' read replica's replication-lag window acceptable?
questions.answer: Low risk if chosen: zones change rarely; the app already defaults Scan/Hit reads to 'zod'; worst case a just-recorded final scan lags sub-second and slightly undercounts the zone breakdown — not a correctness break. (Still a data-semantics tradeoff feeding the fix-approach question below.)

questions.q: AC-3 SCOPE (MATERIAL): what should 'alerts or records a skip reason' require?
questions.answer: RELABEL ONLY. Add a build/query-timeout-specific summary_skipped_reason (e.g. 'build_failed') so failed() no longer mislabels a DB timeout as 'mail_failed'; keep the existing Log::error (Nightwatch already ingests it). Do NOT add a new proactive alert channel (the repo has none today).

questions.q: FIX APPROACH (MATERIAL — data semantics): query-shape CTE vs re-route to zod replica vs both?
questions.answer: QUERY-SHAPE CTE. Rewrite buildZoneSummaries() with a MATERIALIZED CTE that pre-filters public.scans by kit_id+scanned_at before the ST_Contains join, KEEPING the read on the current (write) 'platform' connection. Do NOT re-route to the 'zod' read replica (avoids replica-lag undercount of freshest scans). bbox (&&) pre-filter is optional belt-and-suspenders at the implementer's discretion.

notes: 'zod' and 'platform' are two Laravel connection configs on the SAME physical Postgres DB (same host/port/database=zod), differing only in search_path ('public' vs 'platform') and sticky (platform=true). buildZoneSummaries schema-qualifies public.scans/platform.zones so it is search_path-independent.

Cross-connection TEST-ISOLATION gap: BuildShiftSummaryTest docblock (17-25) documents that the scans⋈zones join is untested because scans (Scan model, 'zod') and the raw-SQL zone read ('platform') are separate PG sessions under RefreshDatabase — uncommitted writes are mutually invisible even though TestCase::connectionsToTransact lists both. A new pinning test MUST seed scans via DB::connection('platform')->table('scans')->insert(...) (same connection as the read) and build the Zone geometry via Zone::rebuildGeometryFromDefinition() (Zone.php:251) or ST_Contains never matches. [platform-qa memory: cross-connection joins return empty in tests.]
DEV-2309 test style is the template: enableQueryLog() then assert the emitted SQL shape (here: PRESENCE of the CTE fence / bbox, not absence).
buildZoneSummaries counts ALL scans incl hidden (raw SQL bypasses ShowVisibleScan) — pre-existing behavior; the fix MUST preserve it (no is_visible filter).

Secondary risk (NOT required by ACs): handle() holds lockForUpdate on kit_shifts across the whole build — 3 ClickHouse round trips + the PG join + a SYNCHRONOUS Mail::send(). Long lock hold + external I/O in a DB transaction. Optional follow-up; do NOT narrow without a claim/CAS mechanism (idempotency).

'Why now' hypothesis (candidate 2, infra): public.scans has a DEFAULT catch-all partition; if prod pg_partman maintenance stalled after ~2026-04, a bloated DEFAULT partition would independently degrade pruning for ANY date-ranged scans query. DBA check worth raising to the reporter; the code fix still helps regardless.

No proactive alert channel is wired for ANY job today (Horizon Slack routing commented out, no LOG_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL). Nightwatch ingests Log::error (config/nightwatch.php log_level=debug), so terminal failures ARE observable in Nightwatch already.
MapboxStaticMapBuilder::build() only builds a URL string (no HTTP call) — not network I/O under the lock.
kit_shifts.summary_skipped_reason is varchar(64), no check constraint — a new label ('build_failed') needs no migration.
